identificationModule.briefTitle: Radiation Therapy With or Without Temozolomide in Treating Older Patients With Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma Multiforme
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized Phase III Study of Temozolomide and Short-Course Radiation Versus Short-Course Radiation Alone In The Treatment of Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma Multiforme in Elderly Patients

interventions.name: temozolomide
interventions.description: Temozolomide (concurrent with radiation) 75 mg/m2 PO 3 weeks once a day, daily, from the first day to the last day of radiotherapy, but for no longer than 28 days, and then adjuvantly for up to 12 cycles (150 mg/m2 for the first 5 days of each cycle). Adjuvant TMZ may be escalated to 200mg/m2 in C2 onward if appropriate.

interventions.name: DNA methylation analysis
interventions.description: A stratified log-rank test, adjusting for the stratification factors (except centre) plus MGMT promoter methylation status, will be used as the primary method to compare the overall survival between the two arms

interventions.name: quality-of-life assessment
interventions.description: prior to randomization until end of study
